name: FFS_PLUGIN
description: Contains a list of plugins configured in the system.

columns.name: PLUGIN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of Plugin, automatically populated by the system.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Legacy column, is not used. Removed in 24C.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type defines attributes and functionality available to plugin. Possible options: 'addon' - plugin that utilizes the field service plugin framework; 'external' - external application opened as a web link; 'external_native' - external application opened as another application on the same device; 'internal' - reserved legacy option, is not used.

columns.name: PATH
columns.description: Url of the main page of plugin. Does not contain scheme and domain part for plugins hosted internally by Field Service (Plugin Archive, Standard Plugin). May does not contain scheme and domain part for External Applications (TYPE is 'external_native').

columns.name: POST_DATA
columns.description: Data sent in the body of post request for External Applications. Fields separated by new line character.

columns.name: PRIVILEGE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_PRIVILEGE_OBJECT.PRIVILEGE_OBJECT_ID value.

columns.name: WIDTH
columns.description: Dialog width in pixels for External Application opened as web link (applicable when TYPE is 'external').

columns.name: HEIGHT
columns.description: Dialog height in pixels for External Application opened as web link (applicable when TYPE is 'external').

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Bit mask represents plugin attributes. 1 - plugin_option_tab_layout, 2 - plugin_option_scrollbars - applicable only if TYPE is 'external_native', 4 - plugin_option_is_online - Whether to show the plugin in offline or not, 8 - plugin_option_is_server_script - Reserved legacy option. Has no effect, 16 - plugin_option_menu_item, 32 - plugin_option_property_config - Reserved legacy option. Has no effect since 20c, 64 - plugin_option_standard_plugin - plugin is a Standard Plugin.

columns.name: USER_AGENT_MASK
columns.description: Regular expression. Field service sorts all records that have the same ACTION_LINK_ID by sort_order and opens as another application path of the first record whose USER_AGENT_MASK matches the browser's user agent string (applicable only if TYPE is 'external_native').

columns.name: SORT_ORDER
columns.description: Order position used to determine the priority of the USER_AGENT_MASK to be applied first (applicable only if TYPE is 'external_native').

columns.name: NATIVE_APP_LABEL
columns.description: External Application label (applicable only if TYPE is 'external_native').

columns.name: ACTION_LINK_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_ACTION_LINK.ACTION_LINK_ID value. Action Link ID that the plugin is associated with. One plugin associated with one Action Link ID.

columns.name: AUTH_TYPE
columns.description: Type of authentication used by the external server hosting the plug-in source to verify access to the plug-in. Possible options: 'basic', 'hmac'.

columns.name: AUTH_LOGIN
columns.description: User name to log in to the plug-in. Applicable only if AUTH_TYPE is 'basic'.

columns.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
columns.description: Password to log in to the plug-in. Applicable only if AUTH_TYPE is 'basic'.

columns.name: PLUGIN_HOSTED_ID
columns.description: Relation to FFS_PLUGIN_HOSTED.PLUGIN_HOSTED_ID VALUE. If it contains some value means that plugin is hosted internally by Field Service (Plugin Archive).

columns.name: SECURED_DATA
columns.description: Data of plugin parameters. Applicable only if TYPE is 'addon'.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
